Method of Attack: Cryptocurrency mining via exploitation of Apache Struts CVE-2018-11776 vulnerability to infect servers with a miner downloaded from a BitBucket repository
Impacted Systems: Apache Struts-based web applications versions 2.3 to 2.3.34 and 2.5 to 2.5.16
Attack Vector: Remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2018-11776 in Apache Struts
